title: Correction to: CRISPR-Based Diagnosis of Infectious and Noninfectious Diseases
author: vangah, Katalani, et al.

steps_raw.instruction: In the original publication of this article [1], there was an error in the article, the authors opted to correct the last name of co-author Hannah Abigail Boone from Booneh to Boone. The original article has been corrected.
